breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly applies the Stokes drag formula (Fd = 3πμDV) without computing the Reynolds number or checking whether the flow is in the creeping-flow regime. At Re ≈ 2500, Stokes drag is entirely inappropriate. The ground truth requires computing Re first and, since Re is not << 1, using a Cd(Re) correlation with Fd = (1/2)ρV²CdA. The generated specification repeats the original error.
